apps.name: JavaScript
apps.does: Modern JavaScript (ES2024) with QuickJS-ng: interactive prompt, scripts and modules, std/os file APIs, timers. Type js, or js file.js.

apps.name: Lua
apps.does: Lua 5.4 in the Terminal: interactive prompt and scripts. Type lua for the prompt, lua script.lua to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: RetroLove
apps.does: Three arcade classics in one: Pong, Breakout and Asteroids, vector style, with touch controls and keyboard. A LÖVE game running unchanged on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: SQLite
apps.does: The SQLite shell: local SQL databases on the SD card, with JSON and math functions. Type sqlite3 notes.db.

apps.name: Sudoku
apps.does: Endless Sudoku in three levels: a fresh puzzle every time, clashes shown in red, timer and best times, the game kept when you leave. Touch or keyboard.

apps.name: ABC 123
apps.does: Learn letters and numbers with 7 mini-games. Multilingual, with voice.

apps.name: Air quality
apps.does: Air quality where you are: European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO2, ozone, UV index and pollen, with the next 24 hours. Open-Meteo data (CAMS), no account or key; search any city.

apps.name: Cannon
apps.does: Artillery arcade: drag your finger to set angle and power, lift it to fire.

apps.name: Chess
apps.does: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

apps.name: CHIP-8 Arcade
apps.does: 83 homebrew games from the CHIP-8 Community Archive (CC0) in a CHIP-8 / SUPER-CHIP / XO-CHIP console. On-screen keypad, gamepad and keyboard, colours and sound.

apps.name: Converter
apps.does: Unit converter for twelve quantities: length, mass, temperature, volume, area, speed, pressure, energy, data, time, angle and fuel consumption. Type once, read every unit at the same time.

apps.name: Devices
apps.does: Shelly, WLED and Tasmota on your Wi-Fi, found automatically: see which are on and switch them with a tap. No Home Assistant, no cloud.

apps.name: Doom Engine
apps.does: The classic Doom engine (doomgeneric, from Chocolate Doom) tuned for this board: 4:3 picture, OPL music, keyboard, mouse and gamepads. Runs the Doom games from the Store and your own WADs.

apps.name: Home
apps.does: Home Assistant dashboard by room

apps.name: openHASP
apps.does: openHASP (HASwitchPlate): touch pages for Home Assistant described in JSONL and driven over MQTT. Works with the openHASP integration from HACS.

apps.name: Pianino
apps.does: A colourful kids piano: rainbow keys and four instrument presets.

apps.name: Pomodoro Desk Hub
apps.does: Smart 7-inch desk dashboard: Pomodoro focus timer, monthly calendar, productivity stats, and dim night stand mode.

apps.name: Puzzles
apps.does: Simon Tatham's Portable Puzzle Collection: 40 logic puzzles (Bridges, Keen, Light Up, Loopy, Mines, Net, Pattern, Solo, Tents, Untangle...). Undo, solver, puzzle types; games are saved. MIT.

apps.name: Python
apps.does: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) for scripts and quick calculations: python -c 'print(2**64)' or write ~/x.py then python ~/x.py. No pip, threads or sockets.

apps.name: Timer
apps.does: Stopwatch and countdown with an end beep. Big, tap-friendly digits.

apps.name: Vertice Bass
apps.does: Arcade fishing tournament in 3D: drive the boat, cast, work the lure, set the hook and fight the fish against the clock. Six lakes, eight species, four lures, weather and time of day, a soundtrack and a top-10 record...

apps.name: Vertice GP
apps.does: 3D kart racing on the Vertice engine: four karts, three laps, drift turbo, boost pads, coins, rocket starts and slipstream. Touch, keyboard or gamepad.

apps.name: Weather
apps.does: Live global weather and forecasts powered by Open-Meteo with geolocation, settings, and animated graphics.

apps.name: Zigbee
apps.does: Zigbee2MQTT on the panel: devices appear by themselves, toggle lights and plugs, see temperature, humidity, doors, motion and battery. Needs the MQTT broker in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Zork I-III
apps.does: Zork I, II and III, the classic 1980 text adventures, free under the MIT license. Type zork in the Terminal, or zork 2 for Zork II. SAVE and RESTORE keep one game per title.
Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048. Swipe in any direction; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: BASIC
apps.does: Classic line-numbered BASIC: print/if/goto/gosub/for-next/input. Type basic prog.bas to run a program from /sdcard/home. Lowercase keywords, single-letter variables a-z.

apps.name: dateutils
apps.does: Date arithmetic: days between dates, date + N days/weeks/months/business days, date series, formats. Run: datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25 | dateadd 2026-10-02 +10b

apps.name: Eigenmath
apps.does: Exact symbolic math: derivatives, integrals, roots, matrices, big integers, fractions. Run: eigenmath -e 'integral(x^2*exp(x),x)' (one -e per expression, one-line result).

apps.name: GNU units
apps.does: Converts and computes with 3000+ units of measure. Hours are hr, temperatures tempC(37). Run: units -t '5 mph' 'km/hr' | units -t 'tempF(100)' tempC (currency rates are old)

apps.name: html2text
apps.does: Turns a web page or HTML file into plain text for reading or summarising (no JS-rendered content). Run: curl -s URL | html2text [-links] [-width N]

apps.name: lowdown
apps.does: Markdown converter: to formatted Terminal text, HTML page, man, LaTeX or LibreOffice .fodt. Run: lowdown -thtml -s IN.md -o OUT.html | lowdown -tterm IN.md

apps.name: PDFio tools
apps.does: Read PDFs: text of every page, document info, merge PDFs. Run: pdftotext F.pdf | head -100 ; pdfinfo F.pdf ; pdfmerge -o OUT.pdf A.pdf B.pdf (scans: no text)

apps.name: qrencode
apps.does: Makes QR codes: in the Terminal for a phone to scan, or as an SVG file. Wi-Fi: 'WIFI:S:NAME;T:WPA;P:PASS;;'. Run: qrencode TEXT | qrencode -o FILE.svg TEXT

apps.name: zstd
apps.does: Compress/decompress .zst .gz .xz files. Run: gunzip -k F.gz | zcat F.gz | unxz F.xz | xz -k F | zstd F | zstd -d F.zst (no tar: .tar.gz -> .tar)

apps.name: bc calculator
apps.does: bc, the arbitrary-precision calculator: numbers with as many digits as you want, functions, and a math library (bc -l). Type bc and write expressions like 2^200 or sqrt(2).

apps.name: Berry
apps.does: Berry, a small object-oriented scripting language for microcontrollers: interactive prompt and scripts. Type berry for the prompt, berry script.be to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: Checkers
apps.does: English draughts for two players on one screen: tap a piece, then tap where it goes; captures are compulsory. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Compressed
apps.does: A game in under 200 lines: dodge and stomp the falling blocks, chain stomps for a combo. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: FIGlet
apps.does: FIGlet writes text in big letters made of characters, with 15 built-in fonts. Type figlet Hello, or figlet -f slant Hello; figlet --list shows the fonts.

apps.name: Fly Swatter
apps.does: Swat the flies before they swarm the screen, and mind the bombs. Tap where the fly is. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Game Boy
apps.does: Game Boy player (Peanut-GB, MIT): plays your own .gb games from /sdcard/home/roms with touch controls, gamepads, sound and battery saves. Homebrew: hh.gbdev.io.

apps.name: Glulxe
apps.does: Modern interactive fiction (Inform 7 / Glulx) in the Terminal. Copy a .gblorb or .ulx story to /sdcard/home, then type glulxe story.gblorb. Thousands of free games on ifdb.org.

apps.name: Gravity Wars
apps.does: Artillery among the planets: aim, choose the power and let gravity bend the shot towards the other ship. Two players on one screen. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: jq
apps.does: jq, the command-line JSON processor: filter, transform and pretty-print JSON files, with regular expressions. Type jq '.name' data.json, or pipe JSON into it.

apps.name: JSON
apps.does: Validate, pretty-print, minify and query JSON files: cjson file.json, cjson -c file.json (compact), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (pick a value), cjson -l file.jsonl (one value per line).

apps.name: Lua App
apps.does: The engine of the Store's Lua apps: Lua 5.4 with drawing, anti-aliased text, touch, keys, gamepads, timers, storage, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT and Home Assistant, plus a LÖVE compatibility layer. On its own it runs the...

apps.name: Markdown
apps.does: Render Markdown to HTML: md notes.md (HTML on stdout), md -f -o out.html notes.md (full document), md --gfm (GitHub-flavored tables/strikethrough/task lists).

apps.name: Minesweeper
apps.does: The classic mine-clearing puzzle: tap a cell to open it, numbers tell how many mines touch it. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Moon Pong
apps.does: Pong against the computer. Hold the on-screen arrows (or Up/Down on a keyboard or pad) to move your paddle. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: MQTT Explorer
apps.does: See what flows on your MQTT broker: topics as they arrive, payloads with JSON pretty-printed, a short history per topic, publish test messages. Uses the broker set in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Mr. Rescue
apps.does: A fireman with a water cannon fights his way up burning buildings, throws the people he rescues out of the windows and faces the arsonist bosses. On-screen d-pad, Jump, Water, Grab. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Panda Shooter
apps.does: A tiny shooter: move left and right and hit the bouncing panda boss before it gets you. On-screen arrows and Fire, or a keyboard or pad. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: pForth
apps.does: pForth, a portable ANS Forth: stack-based interactive programming, with floating point and file words. Type pforth for the prompt, pforth file.fth to load a file.

apps.name: Robo House
apps.does: A one-screen platformer: run, climb the ladders and jump over the robots to rescue the kittens in the house. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: RPN Calc
apps.does: A reverse Polish notation calculator in the HP tradition: unlimited stack, undo, memory, trigonometry in degrees or radians, logarithms, powers and factorials. The stack is kept between sessions.

apps.name: Scheme
apps.does: TinyScheme, a small Scheme (R5RS subset): interactive prompt and scripts, with 64-bit integers, floats, strings, vectors and files. Type scheme for the prompt, scheme file.scm to run a file.

apps.name: Slide Puzzle
apps.does: The fifteen puzzle: put the numbered tiles back in order. Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it, or swipe. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Sword of the Orc King
apps.does: A turn-based roguelike in progress: explore the dungeon, fight orcs and bats, pick up what you find. On-screen d-pad and buttons, or a keyboard. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Synth
apps.does: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

apps.name: Tcl
apps.does: Tcl in the Terminal (Jim Tcl): interactive prompt and scripts, with lists, dicts, regexp, OO and file I/O. Type tcl for the prompt, tcl script.tcl to run a file.

apps.name: Tetronimo
apps.does: A clean falling-blocks puzzle: tap to rotate, swipe left or right to move, swipe down to drop. Keyboard: arrows, space, P to pause. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Tic Tac Toe
apps.does: Noughts and crosses against a friend or an unbeatable minimax bot with three levels. Tap to play. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Total Breakout
apps.does: Break all the bricks with the ball and the paddle. On-screen arrows and Go, or a keyboard or pad. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Ubo
apps.does: A Qix-like: draw lines to cut off parts of the field and claim them while the enemies roam. On-screen d-pad and Draw. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Wormy
apps.does: The snake game: eat the apples, grow longer, do not bite yourself or the walls. Swipe to turn; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Wren
apps.does: Wren, a small, fast class-based scripting language: interactive prompt and scripts, with a mini io module (Stdin, File). Type wren for the prompt, wren script.wren to run a file.

apps.name: Zip
apps.does: Create, list and extract .zip archives: zip archive.zip file1 file2 (create), zip -l archive.zip (list), zip -x archive.zip [dir] (extract).

platforms.name: WASM-4
platforms.desc: Fantasy console carts by the wasm4.org community.

platforms.name: Game Boy
platforms.desc: Free homebrew Game Boy games, ready to play.

platforms.name: Arduboy
platforms.desc: Open-source games of the credit-card sized Arduboy.

platforms.name: Doom
platforms.desc: Free games and megawads for the Doom engine.

platforms.name: Interactive fiction
platforms.desc: Classic and modern text adventures, played in the Terminal.
